thread: The south road runs through Arthas's army near Strahnbrad; Jaina's read is the only evidence for it

evidence.clue: Two men in good brown coats at a south-road inn: the army (Prince Arthas) has taken every remount and oat at the King's price; he is at Strahnbrad against orcs from the camps who are burning farms in the hills; soldiers on every road that way. The toll-keeper: a company of King's foot cut across a week ago for the hill road and the prince; they do not pay.
Cyndia walks the south road to the first bridge: iron-tyred army wagons going up full and coming down lighter, shod with the King's post-horse flat shoe; road climbs into the hills.

Jaina's read at the fork: the south road is heavy as far down as she can hear, older at the bottom with a thin new layer on top going the same way; the King's road is thin and clean; the light on her staff leans to the south bend. 'As sure as Brent's.' Her marks have matched every book she could check (Hollow Green, Ashford corrected).

Sylvanas: the King's road goes into Andorhal by the front gate, straight, drained and clean, a lord's door; the south road is the one the grain comes up, going round through the hills past Strahnbrad and into Andorhal by the back. She cannot verify it ('a road she could not check') and declines the re-read: 'No.' She expects the army to get in the way: 'they'll put the flour after the orcs, and after the horses, and after the quartermaster's supper.' Jaina: 'Then I'll have to show it to them.'
At dawn on the south road, a long, pale-brown smear low over the hills ahead 'too brown for mist, and it was moving.' (Unidentified.)

Chapter 6: the smear resolves as army traffic dust with smoke going up into it from behind the hill; wagons come down empty and go up loaded; at the top of the cut the Strahnbrad camp fills the slope. Jaina's read (heavy, old under new) held on the road she rode, and the army's wagons ride that same road.

Chapter 6: Sylvanas's prediction is confirmed to Arthas's face: 'He's going to write to his father, Proudmoore, and then he's going back up that hill.' 'Yes. I am.' Jaina concedes aloud: 'You were right. At the fork.' Sylvanas: 'He's a good commander, with an enemy he can see... And the other one? Is ours.'

notes_chapter6: Resolved: the south road runs through Arthas's army; the army will not act on the warning. The consequence thread is arthas-refusal-and-the-letter.
readerKnows: The party chose the south road on Jaina's unchecked read; an army is in the way; an unidentified brown smear is moving over the hills.
povCharacterKnows: Sylvanas: the army is on the south road, the road is the one the grain comes up (per Jaina), and she cannot check it. Does not know what the smear is.
notes: Chapter 6 opens on the same four riders on the south road heading toward the Strahnbrad military zone before Andorhal. The smear is deliberately unidentified; keep it open.
